referee_caveats_inferred: The abstract/conclusion outflow mass, (1.1–2.3)×10^9 M⊙, differs from the Cycle 6 table/body mass, (1.3–2.8)×10^9 M⊙; retain both as separate answer keys.
Conclusion item 5 reverses the body’s AGN-luminosity assignments for momentum boosts and prints 03×10^46; use the explicitly documented body assignments.
Reported jet-power scenario ordering and coupling efficiencies need arithmetic reconciliation with the printed intrinsic fluxes and outflow power.
The SED table gives stellar-mass uncertainty ±2×10^10 M⊙ for the 44 GHz fit, while the BH-mass section prints ±0.4×10^10 M⊙.
